title: Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry
description:
Complete Cambridge IGCSE Chemistry course covering the 0620 syllabus.

Topics include:
• States of matter
• Atoms, elements and compounds
• Stoichiometry
• Electrochemistry
• Chemical energetics
• Chemical reactions
• Acids, bases and salts
• The Periodic Table
• Metals
• Chemistry of the environment
• Organic chemistry

Includes worked examples, practice problems, and past paper questions.
